welcome.title: Welcome to Voyager
welcome.body: Plan trips with AI: flights, hotels, activities and a day-by-day itinerary, all in one place.

howYouTravel.title: How do you travel?
howYouTravel.body: Six quick questions tailor Voyager to you. You can skip any of them.

homeAndPassport.title: Home and passport
homeAndPassport.body: Tell us where you fly from and which passport you hold, so we can check visas and find the right flights.

notifications.title: Stay on top of your trips
notifications.body: Get trip reminders and price-drop alerts. You can turn each one off in Settings.

firstTrip.title: Plan your first trip
firstTrip.body: Search for a destination, or ask Voyager to surprise you.

companions.title: Who do you usually travel with?

options.ahead_deals: Book far ahead and hunt deals

LUXURY.description: Premium hotels, fine dining and private tours.

ADVENTURE.name: Adventurer
ADVENTURE.description: Outdoors, active days and room for the unexpected.

CULTURE_FOODIE.name: Culture Seeker & Foodie
CULTURE_FOODIE.description: History, art, local food and what's on in town.
